entities.summary: Postojna Cave in Slovenia combines an underground railway ride with exploration of a large visitor cave.
entities.description: At Postojna Cave, the underground railway makes entering the large cave system part of the experience. The scale of the visitor route gives the outing a theatrical sense of travelling into another landscape. It suits groups with children around five and older through adults. Check current visitor arrangements and individual activity restrictions before going.
entities.whyWorthwhile: Postojna Cave in Slovenia makes its underground railway and large cave route a distinctive combined journey.
